questions.prompt: What is the highest natural point in Singapore?

source.note: Bukit Timah Hill stands about 163 m high. Check: National Parks Board, Bukit Timah Nature Reserve.

questions.prompt: Counting overseas territories, which country spans the most time zones?

source.note: France uses 12 time zones through its overseas territories; Russia and the United States use 11 each. Check: Britannica, 'time zone'.

questions.prompt: Which is the oldest reservoir in Singapore?

source.note: MacRitchie was completed in 1868 as the Impounding Reservoir. Check: PUB and National Parks Board pages on MacRitchie Reservoir.
